facts.what: Sarah 坐 Finn 开的 Jeep（Indestructible Tonka）出门，打电话约社工 Kristen 二十分钟后在她家旁的公园见面。
facts.anchor: Ummm… Yes, of course. Umm… meet me at the park by your house in twenty?

facts.what: Sarah 向 Finn 坦白 nibble 事件：她当时把 Ethan 扑倒在地、像动物一样骑上去并吻了他。
facts.anchor: I was mortified! I even threw Ethan to his back and crawled on top of him like an animal!

facts.what: Finn 向 Sarah 道歉多年的嫉妒：因为 Ethan 多年来一直注视着 Sarah 的一举一动，他曾嫉妒到几乎恨过她。
facts.anchor: The way Ethan has watched your every move, for years, made me so envious I kind of… hated you.

facts.what: Sarah 面责 Kristen：你把 Blue 带给我们又送回那个女人和她的施虐者身边、帮忙掩盖了 Caleb 的死、还在大家最需要时把 Johnny 带走。
facts.anchor: You helped cover up Caleb’s death.” My voice broke, but I kept talking, pushing through the pain.

facts.what: Kristen 翻开带来的厚档案，封面黑字写着 JOHNNY WATTS；她还确认 Johnny 这名字并非真名。
facts.anchor: As she flipped through it, I saw the name JOHNNY WATTS on the cover in black ink.

facts.what: Sarah 情急说漏了收养人的名字 Styx；Kristen 称自己从未听过这个名字，并指 Johnny 的家人正竭力不让他留下任何痕迹。
facts.anchor: Styx,” I cut in, too emotional to remember I wasn’t supposed to speak that name until Finn looked at me with the widest eyes.

facts.what: 被 Finn 逼问后 Kristen 让步说有个号码可以打，她拨给联系人 River 后回来谎称打错了；Sarah 由此确知 Caleb 的凶手已死并当场晕厥。
facts.anchor: As if all energy had been drained from her, she tapped on her phone. The name River was all I could see.

facts.what: 回家时虚脱的 Sarah 被 Ethan 抱进屋，有人低语 anniversary（周年纪念日），她才想起今天是哪个日子。
facts.anchor: past worried faces and someone whispering ‘anniversary’, I remembered what day it was.
